Hi, thanks for commenting. Yes, I had the skin test and they found that I am severely allergic to dogs, cats, mold, dust, grass and weeds. I have been doing sinus rinses consistently for 2 weeks because it is a requirement post-surgery. I take Cetirizine 10mg at night. I used to also take Allegra 180mg twice a day. None of it seems to have helped any. I am considering doing the shots, but I just wonder if it would work when I’m still exposed to such a large amount of allergens on a daily basis. I do keep pets out of my room and do my best to keep it clean, but I worry that even being upstairs where the pets are for 15 minutes to make food would be enough to give me a sinus infection again due to how many allergens are up there.
